question: According to Union Budget 2025–26, which mission was launched to document and conserve India’s manuscript heritage?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Granth Sanrakshan Abhiyan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Granth Sanrakshan Abhiyan** was launched under the Union Budget 2025–26 to preserve and document **India’s manuscript heritage**, which spans centuries and contains invaluable knowledge.
 
• This mission aims to safeguard ancient manuscripts and texts that are historically and culturally significant, ensuring that they remain accessible to future generations.
 
• India is home to approximately **5 million manuscripts**, considered one of the richest repositories of manuscript heritage globally.
 
• Through this initiative, the government plans to set up a **centralized digital archive** to catalog and digitize manuscripts, thereby protecting them from physical decay or loss.
 
• The mission will also focus on **training archivists** and manuscript conservationists, encouraging research, and promoting awareness about the importance of preserving India’s literary heritage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Manuscript Heritage in India:**

 
 
• India’s manuscripts include works in languages such as **Sanskrit, Prakrit, Tamil, Persian, Arabic, and Urdu**, among others.
 
• The manuscripts cover diverse fields like **philosophy, literature, science, mathematics, medicine, astronomy, and art**.
 
• Important manuscript collections are housed in institutions like the **National Archives of India** and the **Indira Gandhi National Centre for the Arts (IGNCA)**.
 
 
 
• **Challenges in Conservation:**
 
 
• Many manuscripts are stored in **improper conditions**, leading to their physical deterioration due to humidity, pests, and handling.
 
• The lack of **trained conservators** and inadequate funding for preservation efforts are major hurdles.
 
• Digitization is a key solution to ensure the long-term accessibility and safety of these texts.
 
 
 
• **Government Initiatives for Heritage Preservation:**
 
 
• The **National Mission for Manuscripts (NMM)**, launched in 2003, is a government initiative to document and conserve manuscripts.
 
• Under NMM, manuscripts have been digitized and cataloged to prevent their loss.
 
• The **Granth Sanrakshan Abhiyan** complements such efforts by focusing on comprehensive conservation and awareness.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Manuscript Preservation:**
 
 
• Preserving manuscripts helps in understanding India’s **ancient knowledge systems** and cultural history.
 
• It aids scholars and researchers in exploring **historical, scientific, and philosophical advancements** documented in these texts.
 
• Manuscripts serve as a bridge connecting modern society with **ancestral wisdom**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Granth Sanrakshan Abhiyan** emphasizes collaboration with **academic institutions**, libraries, and cultural organizations to maximize the impact of manuscript conservation efforts.
 
• The initiative also aims to create **public awareness campaigns** to highlight the importance of preserving India’s rich literary heritage.
 
• Private collectors and regional archives are encouraged to contribute to the national repository under this mission.
 
• Technology plays a pivotal role in digitization, with advanced tools used for **high-resolution scanning** and metadata creation.
